newsitem.title: PERU: Peru ministers make routine resignation offer.
newsitem.headline: Peru ministers make routine resignation offer.

text.p: Peru's ministers have all formally offered to resign as part of a routine annual move by the cabinet prior to the president's speech to the nation on the July 28 Independence Day, officials confirmed Wednesday.
"This is nothing new. It happens every year. The ministers place their jobs in the hands of the president to ratify or not on July 28," a presidential palace spokeswoman told Reuters.
"Perhaps there will be changes, perhaps not."

Facing an unprecedented fall in popularity polls, President Alberto Fujimori is widely expected to make some major cabinet changes at the end of this month to give fresh impetus to his administration.
